**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restraint on Mortgage Logic.com as Client:

- **§ 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client)** — the most likely home for a business restraint — contains only compliance-with-laws, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access limitation, content reps, and anti-spam provisions. No competitive covenant.
- **§ 2(a)** is affirmatively helpful to us: Client "is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," limited only by TrueLink's IP rights and our § 10 confidentiality obligations. That is effectively the internal-development/acquisition carve-out the fallback would demand, granted outright.
- The "ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables" language in § 2(a) is a scope-of-licence limit on how the Interface may be used, not a limit on what businesses we may run or what we may buy or build — noted, not flagged.
- **§ 8(d)**'s reference to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" cuts in our favour here, since it limits *TrueLink's* rights to use Credit Data. That instrument is not part of this document and is undefined within it — worth diligencing separately for any restraint on Client, but nothing in this Agreement restrains us.

Recorded at the preferred position; no changes requested.
